description:
## 2.5.1-dev.11

- docs: correct issue forms for unsupported builds and roadmap
- chore: pin editor scope and shell script line endings
- docs: mark superseded gesture analyses and current undo path
- docs: correct settings, toolbar and flag derivations
- docs: refresh contributor gate, APK tooling and release guide
- docs: align feature guide and roadmap with shipped behavior
- docs(changelog): restore missing dev and stable release entries
- docs: record full-repository findings and fix status
- fix(gate): protect provider and verify the pushed tree
- fix(release): make recovery resumable and stamp bundle sources
- fix(driver): enforce patch selection and output handling
- fix(checks): enforce generated artifacts and source contracts
- fix(preflight): pin current Gboard bindings and flag defaults
- fix(apk): validate resource replay and improve APK readers
- fix(verify): follow real control flow and inspect same-size edits
- fix(extension): harden settings, hotkeys, and crash diagnostics
- fix(settings): guard resource metadata and defaults
- fix(toolbar): validate native registration and capacity seams
- fix(flags): validate isolated and long-valued flag rewrites
- fix(patches): harden shared resolution and gesture emissions
- fix(signature): bypass only Gboard's own startup check
